# ankra_morpheus_groups (Data Source)

The HPE Morpheus groups behind a credential, for `group_id` on `ankra_morpheus_cluster`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster morpheus groups`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_morpheus_groups" "all" {
  credential_id = ankra_morpheus_credential.main.id
}

output "morpheus_groups" {
  value = { for group in data.ankra_morpheus_groups.all.groups : group.name => group.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Group id.
- `location` (String) Location, when set.
- `name` (String) Group name.
